_comment: Demo photography manifest. Every entry names a Wikimedia Commons file under a free licence.
`subject` is what the photograph ACTUALLY shows and is rendered as the credit line in the app,
so a representative image is never passed off as a photograph of a different place.
Run `python3 fetch.py` from this directory to (re)download and regenerate the credits.
